segments.en: One should fix set times for Torah study and study with joy — not interrupting one's learning for anything not absolutely necessary. One should intend through the learning to merit complete faith, and strive to draw from the learning correct guidance for the service of Hashem Yisborach. One should also innovate in Torah — according to the foundations of the da'as of Rabbainu — and through this one draws close to Hashem Yisborach in truth and brings those far away near to the service of Hashem Yisborach.
